review.reviewer: GPT in Work, contextual label sample and focused pair inspection

quality_review_audit.source_metadata: All draft items are GPT-authored original text. The parts supply no source attribution. Style was inferred from explicit format cues; unsampled rationales quote an extracted passage and are not independent labeling decisions.
quality_review_audit.sample: 50 contextual checks, including all four classes and both paragraph/long lengths. Labels on the authoring artifacts were visible during the run.

selected_pair_checks.reason: Both told the same story of an old loan letter cancelling a poster sale and its renovation funding.
Both used repeated reader measurements against a reference to stop delivery.
Both used overlapping tree crowns and manual counts to stop the same expansion.
Sentence summarized the same optical comparison and development decision.
Both disclosed irretrievable ownership evidence for the same district collection.
Both rehearsal reports concerned confusing file names and numbering as the fix.
A projector produces low-quality output in one record; a mismatch between image colors and the selected caption drives the other.
One compares how the same melody sounds with different instrumental groups; the other asks listeners to describe their response to a single public rehearsal.

other_text_edits_by_final_id.1632: Clarify that the loss of explanatory channels affects the entire district.

quality_review_audit.routine_similarity: 552 final E5 alerts were logged. None crossed the configured blocking thresholds. Only selected pairs were manually inspected.
quality_review_audit.diversity_notes: 19 scenarios, no recorded public-source adaptations or Latin text in the supplied batch. Several source scenarios and fact patterns recur. Preserve this coverage information in later cumulative planning.
